email_body:
Hi,

I noticed that Cal.com is one of the best options for scheduling software for small business thanks to a free tier that includes unlimited event types, workflow automation, Stripe payments, and Cal Video, making it the most generous free scheduling tool available. Small businesses needing booking software with team features can upgrade to Teams at $16/user/month for round-robin scheduling and shared availability [1]

Given your Head of Go-to-Market role, I wanted to reach out.

I'm Andrei Ghita, Founder. We help GTM teams send fact-backed cold outreach instead of generic templates.

Open to a 15-minute call this week?

Regards,
Andrei Ghita
